Design (hypothesis): (1) the drill takes the scan's top sources with full text (arXiv HTML, open-access PDFs via OpenAlex oa_url); (2) restructures each into a store: sections, every results-table row, and claims with numbers and conditions, each with exact character offsets in the source (typed triples with provenance, the P11/P21 format); (3) readers query the store (filters or SQL) and get only matching rows, sized to the reading model's measured context (P20a), instead of reading documents; every returned row is checked against the text by script; (4) a claim missing its method or baseline triggers a drill into the cited paper, within a fixed per-card budget.
